name: tool_creator
description: Create and validate a narrowly scoped non-dangerous Hsx skill for a missing capability, then register it in the active runtime. Provide the new tool input schema as a JSON-encoded string.
advisory: This writes executable Python and metadata into the Hsx skill area. Review the requested capability and generated code before proceeding.

input_schema_json.description: A JSON string containing the new tool input schema object.
